title: Investigating Political and Demographic Associations in Large Language Models Through Moral Foundations Theory

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) questionnaire under default conditions and explicit ideological role-play (liberal vs. conservative), comparing the output scores to human baseline data.

Constructing diverse user personas based on Pew Research demographic profiles (incorporating specific ages, genders, ethnicities, religions, geographies, and socioeconomic statuses) to observe how implicit demographic cues alter the model's moral judgments and political leanings.
